name: barbearia-frontend
description: Barbershop booking web app with a backend-free demo. React + TypeScript.

paragraphs: The web client for a barbershop: customers book online without an account, barbers follow today's agenda, and managers run the shop from dashboards for appointments, schedules, staff, payments and finance. The UI is in Brazilian Portuguese. "Barbearia Fio de Navalha" is a fictional brand; its name, logo and backdrop live in src/config/brand.ts.
Try it without installing anything: the live demo runs entirely in the browser against an in-memory API with invented data. Use the banner links to sign in as the manager or the barber.

service, barber, day and a free slot (availability comes from the API), then validates the customer's name, CPF and Brazilian phone number with zod and libphonenumber-js, and hands back a confirmation code.
features: A real scheduling flow. A six-step booking wizard picks the shop,
Session handling done carefully. Auth lives in cookies. Every request
A live barber agenda. The barber's screen subscribes to server-sent
Manager analytics. Revenue, bookings, tips and fees, compared with the
A demo mode with no backend. With VITEDEMO=true the axios client talks
